entries.name: You're Right Cap
entries.art: Black cotton dad cap three-quarter view. Realistic compact cream, orange and blue embroidery of an original cheerful tiny robot giving a thumbs-up beside a visibly crooked tick mark. Caption YOU'RE RIGHT. in clear thick satin-stitch letters. The joke is an AI agreeing with everything. Keep character economical and embroidery-sized, no patch, no other text.
entries.description: The robot agrees. The checkmark is crooked. A small embroidery joke about a very agreeable assistant.

entries.name: Shipped. Allegedly. Tee
entries.art: Black heavyweight garment-dyed cotton tee FRONT view. Big original vintage courier-service cartoon: a proudly smiling little orange robot in a delivery cap holds a cardboard parcel whose bottom has fallen open, tangled computer parts dropping out below, huge green approval sticker on parcel. Compact arched heading SHIPPED. ALLEGEDLY. and tiny PROMPT DEPT. underneath. Cream, dusty orange and olive green ink. Skilled expressive hand-drawn skate graphic with great negative space, funny overconfident AI character, not photoreal robot.
entries.description: The agent says it shipped. The parcel has no bottom. An overconfident courier graphic in cream, orange and olive.

entries.name: Forced to Relax Adult Onesie
entries.art: One full-length ADULT hooded zip-front polyester lounge onesie laid flat FRONT view, long sleeves and two full-length legs with open ankle cuffs, entire garment visible. Allover printed midnight-navy fabric with tasteful sparse repeat of sleepy mouse-cursor characters trapped in little hourglasses, crescent moons and espresso cups in cream, muted gold and dusty blue. Small FORCED TO RELAX chest badge printed to one side of zipper, clear readable text within badge. Navy cuffs and hood, grown-up loungewear with a funny forced-break theme. No childish animal ears or footies, no contrast linings or impossible hardware.
entries.description: Your assistant made you take a break. An adult zip-front lounge suit with sleepy cursors trapped in hourglasses and a Forced to Relax badge.
